probes.name: oversize-gate-not-enforced
probes.claim: Tim 14 Oct: "enforce the catalogue validity and 9,000-byte gate in the execution path before any mutation". classify() returns PARKED_OVERSIZE and is unit-tested, but run() never calls it, so the oversize record is sent.

probes.name: rollback-destroys-later-change
probes.claim: Tim 14 Oct: "Rollback must verify that the current value still matches what this run wrote before deleting it. Preserve subsequent changes." rollback() deletes every WRITTEN gid with no pre-delete comparison.

probes.name: incomplete-read-counted-as-verified-null
probes.claim: Tim 14 Oct: "treat missing or incomplete read results as unresolved, not verified null". readBeforeState() skips unreturned nodes, leaving them undefined; rollback() filters on `!== null && !== undefined`, so an id the read never returned lands in verifiedNull.

probes.name: resume-batch-index-collision
probes.claim: planBatches() re-indexes from 0 on every invocation, but batchIndex is stored in the ledger. The reconcile loop selects records by batchIndex alone, with no state filter, so an already-WRITTEN record from an earlier run is pulled into another run's unknown-batch reconciliation, re-stated, re-dispatched, rejected by its own conditional-write protection, and filed as a human-facing conflict.
